trigger: Three author-supervised raw-final-token probes largely predict negative on fixed-H changed-P synthetic diagnostic. Test the unchanged backbone using its existing NLI task-scoring interface.
data: The same complete 16 families / 64 original P/H inputs, including all premise distractors; no text or gold changes.

interface.system: Each backbone original NLI system messages, asserted identical across all existing 112 NLI rows; no original user/RAG/examples
interface.question: what is the relationship between premise:{verbatim P} hypothesis:{verbatim H}
interface.rule: Exact learned_rule_head.RULE; no extra diagnostic-specific instructions
interface.render: Same backbone tokenizer chat template/config, then existing JSON value prefix; no truncation
interface.forward: One singleton HF forward for each code mapping; 128 per backbone, 256 total; no training or generation

aggregation: Softmax only the first two code logits; align native positive/negative, then mean the two probability vectors. Argmax in fixed positive,negative key order; exact ties positive. No calibration, threshold selection, code weighting or labels in requests.
reports: All existing diagnostic endpoint, positive/negative, R5/strong pair, family all-four, noise repair/harm metrics
Every single-mapping decision and average probabilities, mapping disagreements
Matched same-input repairs/harms and paired differences against three frozen supervised probe systems
Source/request/output hashes and all incremental inference costs
freeze: Freeze plan,64 inputs,256 requests,code sources and original-system sources before root GPU scheduling. CPU tokenizer and metadata-poison checks first.
limitations: Interface control jointly changes task instruction,chat formatting,representation position and use of the pretrained LM output head relative to raw-linear probes; cannot isolate one component.
Failure or success diagnoses this finite fictional input set; it does not predict whether any new supervised head will work.
No natural D evaluation, original-format explanation generation or broader generalization claim.
